question: If an object moves from point A to point B ( 50 m east) and returns to point A in 10 seconds, its average velocity is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**0 m/s**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Average velocity** is defined as the total displacement divided by the total time taken. Displacement refers to the shortest straight-line distance between the initial and final positions of the object.
 
• In this scenario, the object moves from **point A to point B** (50 m east) and then returns to **point A**. The **total displacement** is zero because the object returns to its starting point.
 
• The formula for average velocity is: **Average velocity = Total displacement / Total time**
 
• Since the displacement is zero, the average velocity becomes: **0 m/s**.
 
• This calculation is irrespective of the path taken or the speed of movement. Average velocity focuses solely on the starting and ending positions. &l
